title: Privacy Manager
description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Privacy Manager who is best in class, with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle is building a formal, company-wide privacy program on the NIST Privacy Framework, and we are hiring the person who will build it and run it. This is a ground-floor build with the hard parts already cleared: executive sponsorship is in place, the implementation roadmap is defined, and the core program materials are drafted. Your job is to turn that foundation into an operating program, and then to own the program as it matures.

As our Privacy Manager, you will drive the implementation end to end: the enterprise data map, the privacy risk assessments, the privacy review process, the de-identification standard, and the governance rhythm that keeps it all running. This role sits at the intersection of privacy and product. The goal is not to slow the business down; it is to give every data initiative a fast, well-documented path to yes, including the data-driven products and analytics that are central to Sezzle’s strategy. You will ensure our data practices protect our users across the US and Canada while enabling our product and engineering teams to build at speed.

What You’ll Do:

• Build the program: Drive Sezzle’s implementation of the NIST Privacy Framework from roadmap to operating program, including Current and Target Profiles, gap analysis, a prioritized and costed action plan, and ongoing monitoring, aligned with US state and federal requirements (CCPA/CPRA and other state comprehensive privacy laws, GLBA, TCPA) and Canadian privacy laws (PIPEDA and Quebec’s Law 25).

• Run privacy review: Own privacy risk assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for new products, features, and third-party vendors, and operate an intake and disposition process that gives every proposal a fast, documented answer: approved, approved with controls, or needs redesign.

• Own the data map and consumer rights: Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data map in partnership with Engineering, tracking the lifecycle of consumer information, and manage the automation and fulfillment of consumer access, deletion, and opt-out requests.

• Operationalize privacy-enhancing techniques: Administer Sezzle’s de-identification and aggregation standard and its approval workflow so that data-driven products and analytics ship with the right controls designed in from the start.

• Embed privacy-by-design: Partner directly with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams during early-stage development so that privacy requirements are designed in, not bolted on.

• Govern, measure, and report: Run the cadence of Sezzle’s cross-functional privacy working group, maintain the program’s decision log and obligations register, track program metrics, and support executive and board-level reporting. Collaborate closely with the Information Security team to manage, investigate, and mitigate privacy

title: Technical Support Engineer (SIP / VoIP / FoIP)
description:

First, a Word About Fax
Fans of John Oliver’s “How Is This Still A Thing” segments might be amused to learn that fax remains deeply entrenched in the way many companies transact their daily business. Indeed, it seems fax is still very much a thing! In its annual report on the fax industry, Business Research Insights reports that the global fax market size was 2.36 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach 4.25 billion by 2032 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of almost 7%. It’s especially surprising, then, that most modern VoIP/SIP and cloud-based phone companies neither support fax over SIP nor understand how they might do so (until we show them how easy it is). Our fax-approved SIP trunks are ready to go today and fill a vital need in a growing and underserved industry that shows no signs of slowing down for many years to come.
About You
As a Technical Support Engineer you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving customer issues related to SIP trunking, T.38 fax transmissions, call quality, and network configurations. You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and vendors to ensure seamless communication experiences. You are a proud, card-carrying tech-geek with a superhero’s penchant for helping others. You breathe all things engineering, innovation, and data. Logic is your friend, and you use it generously. Equipped with an entrepreneurial attitude, you are relentlessly energetic and excited by new challenges. If you aren’t multi-tasking, it means you are under-challenged. You don’t just capture packets, you use science (not superstition) to tame them.
Your Mission
This is absolutely not an IT help-desk role. We call our support team 'engineers' because of the highly technical nature of troubleshooting SIP and T.38 at industrial scale. You will:

• Provide Tier 1 / Tier 2 support for FoIP and SIP-related technical issues via email, phone and case management system (Zendesk).

• Diagnose and troubleshoot SIP signaling, call setup failures, one-way audio, jitter, latency, and packet loss.

• Analyze SIP traces, PCAP captures, and logs using tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

• Support T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) implementations, troubleshooting failed fax transmissions and improving reliability.

• Work with PBX systems (Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, etc.), VoIP gateways, and SBCs.

• Assist customers with network configurations, NAT traversal and firewall rules.

• Escalate complex issues to engineering teams and collaborate with vendors as needed.

• Take ownership of reported customer issues and see problems through to resolution, ensuring proper recording and closure of all issues.

• Write documentation, knowledge base articles and FAQs, and document troubleshooting steps, best practices and solutions in the company's knowledge base for use by both internal staff and customers.

• Test interoperability of new VoIP/FoIP equipment and create user guides for various IP-PBX and SIP-compatible devices for use with our SIP Trunking service.

Qualifications
Expert-level support is a core component of our brand and is deeply ingrained in our culture. We look for a mix of the technical expertise, troubleshooting skills, and industry knowledge that will be needed to solve complex problems, including:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or combination of education and experience may be considered.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

- Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

- Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

- Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Create and maintain detailed, day-to-day production schedules that translate the production plan into executable work on the manufacturing floor.

Monitor progress, resolve scheduling conflicts, and adapt plans in real time as priorities and conditions change.

Enable predictable delivery of critical fusion hardware while improving efficiency, coordination, and transparency across manufacturing operations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Develop, maintain and continuously optimize detailed production schedules across multiple manufacturing work centers.

Sequence and re-sequence work orders day-to-day to reflect real-time engineering priorities, material availability and manufacturing constraints.

Monitor manufacturing progress in real time and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and bottlenecks, implementing mitigation plans to protect critical program milestones.

Coordinate with the Procurement & Logistics Department to flag near-term material shortages and adjust the schedule to keep work centers running.

Balance day-to-day workloads across internal and external manufacturing resources in line with the capacity plan.

Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to reflect process changes in the active schedule as soon as they take effect.

Partner with Program Managers to keep them informed of schedule status and re-prioritize work when program objectives shift.

Analyze schedule performance and identify emerging risks to delivery timelines, escalating issues before they impact critical milestones.

Generate and monitor key execution metrics, including schedule adherence, work order completion, lead times and work-in-progress.

Contribute to the development of scalable scheduling processes and tools as Proxima transitions from prototype manufacturing to industrial deployment.

WHO YOU ARE

title: AI Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.
Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production.

The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services

- Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately

- Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform

- Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time

- Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality

- Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t

- Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

- 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering

- Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them.

- Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality

- Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement

- Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool

- Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners

- A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs.

This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production.

title: Director, Customer Success
description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem - dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person - someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role
The Director of Customer Success leads the post-sale customer lifecycle across all customer segments, ensuring customers realize measurable value, adopt solutions effectively, and renew and expand over time. This role is accountable for building and scaling a high-performing Customer Success organization operating under a “One Account, One Owner” model, with clear ownership of customer outcomes across Strategic, Enterprise, State, and Transactional accounts.
The Director defines how Customer Success operates-establishing engagement models, operating cadence, and cross-functional alignment-while ensuring consistent execution across the core pillars of Strategic Engagement, Adoption, Expansion, and Retention. The role partners closely with Sales, Project Delivery/Onboarding, Support, Product, and Marketing to deliver a seamless and scalable customer experience.

• Ensure a proactive, outcome-driven approach to customer engagement focused on value realization and measurable impact.

Operating Model & Segmentation

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Establish clear handoffs and accountability across onboarding, Customer Success, and renewals.

• Serve as an escalation point for high-risk or high-impact customer situations to ensure satisfactory customer resolution and support.

• Provide Voice of Customer

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital maternal health, transforming pregnancy and postpartum care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and digital engagement. Our solutions enable OB providers and health systems to monitor patients in real time, improving access, early intervention, and overall outcomes in maternal-fetal health.
About the Role
We are seeking a Qualified Healthcare Provider (QHCP) - Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant, or Certified Nurse Midwife - to join our remote clinical operations team on a fractional or part-time basis.
This role requires active licensure in the state of Texas, as the provider will support patients and clinical partners located in Texas.
In this role, you will leverage your clinical expertise to review vitals data, assess patient communications, and document clinical summaries that support key customer and quality requirements. The QHCP will also participate in targeted patient outreach for elevated readings, symptoms, or follow-up coordination as part of our virtual maternal health model.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced clinician seeking flexible, remote work while contributing meaningfully to a growing digital health company advancing maternal outcomes nationwide.
Time Commitment: Approximately 10-20 hours per week, with flexibility based on business needs and case volume.
Key Responsibilities

• Monitor patient data trends (e.g., blood pressure, weight, symptoms) and identify high-risk cases requiring intervention.

• Perform clinical assessments via phone, telehealth, or messaging to provide education, intervention, and care plan adjustments.

• Provide direct patient education on managing hypertension, gestational diabetes, preeclampsia risks, postpartum recovery, and other maternal health concerns.

• Escalate high-risk cases to the appropriate provider per established protocols.

• Support care coordination by assisting patients with referrals, scheduling follow-ups, and connecting them to additional resources.

• Ensure compliance with RPM protocols by coaching patients on adherence and addressing barriers to engagement.

• Document all clinical interactions in Babyscripts ' care management platform, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

• Clinical Data Review: Analyze patient vitals data (e.g., blood pressure, glucose, weight, symptoms) and message histories to identify trends, risk factors, and potential clinical concerns.

• Clinical Documentation: Create and validate summary notes or Evidence of Care (EoC) reports supporting provider review and quality reporting requirements.

• Patient Outreach: Conduct focused patient outreach via phone or secure messaging to verify readings, reinforce care plans, or assess for warning signs when needed.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure data completeness, appropriate clinical coding alignment, and compliance with Babyscripts protocols and payer requirements.

• Provider Coordination: Escalate abnormal findings or nonresponsive patients per established triage and escalation pathways.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide clinical feedback to support optimization of Babyscripts ’ workflows, triggers, and RPM care logic.

Qualifications

• Active, unrestricted NP, PA, or CNM license in the state of Texas (required).

• Minimum of 3-5 years of clinical experience in OB/GYN, women’s health, maternal-fetal medicine, or related fields.

• Prior experience with remote patient monitoring, telehealth, or population health preferred.

• Strong ability to synthesize data and communicate concise clinical insights.

• Comfort navigating EHRs, care management platforms, and digital tools.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

• Bilingual (Spanish) strongly preferred.

Compensation & Structure

• Type: Fractional / 1099 or W2 part-time (based on preference and local regulations).

• Compensation: Competitive hourly or per-review

title: Principal Rust Engineer
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.
We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Principal Rust Engineer and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward.
At Progress , you'll lead the technical direction of the search engine behind our Agentic RAG product: a distributed Rust platform for vector, full-text and knowledge-graph search, developed in the open as part of the NucliaDB project. You'll work from low-level index data structures up to the distributed architecture, together with ML, product and platform teams, and directly affect the quality, speed and cost of our product.
In this role, you will:

• Own the architecture and roadmap of our distributed search and indexing engine, written in Rust.

• Design and implement vector, full-text and graph indexes (HNSW, quantization, multi-vector, Tantivy) and the query and filtering layer on top of them.

• Evolve how indexes are built, merged, sharded and replicated on object storage, PostgreSQL and NATS.

• Lead large migrations and performance work, based on profiling and benchmarks, without customer downtime.

• Contribute to the Python services, SDKs and PyO3 bindings built on the engine, keeping public APIs stable.

• Keep the system observable, reliable and secure across Kubernetes deployments and CI/CD.

• Write design proposals, review code, mentor senior engineers and represent the project in the open-source community.

Your background:
Technical skills

• Extensive experience building and running high-performance production systems, including technical leadership.

• Expert Rust: async (Tokio), concurrency, memory-mapped I/O, profiling and low-level optimization (e.g. SIMD).

• Deep knowledge of search engine internals: approximate nearest neighbour search, vector quantization, inverted indexes and ranking.

• Experience designing distributed data systems: storage engines, sharding, replication and consistency trade-offs.

• Solid experience with PostgreSQL, object storage (S3, GCS, Azure) and messaging (NATS JetStream or Kafka).

• Strong Python, ideally with PyO3, asyncio, FastAPI and Pydantic.

• Experience running services on Kubernetes with observability and CI/CD (ideally GitHub Actions).

Professional skills

• Ability to set technical direction and deliver it incrementally.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English, including design documents.

• Comfortable owning critical production systems and making decisions under pressure.

• You measure before optimizing and know when to simplify or remove code.

• Willing to mentor others, comfortable in a remote-first, global team.

• Additionally, it would be beneficial if you have:

• Experience with Tantivy, Lucene, vector databases or other search engines.

• Experience with knowledge graphs or graph-based retrieval (GraphRAG).

• Familiarity with embedding models, including multi-vector models (e.g. ColBERT).

• Experience maintaining open-source projects, including dependency auditing and licensing.

If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we'd be happy to chat.
Compensation

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrollment

Vacation, Family, and Health

title: Executive Support Specialist - California Insurance Experience Required
description:
The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks - before anyone notices it almost did.
About RemotePro.ph
We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one - not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.
To apply, please visit us at:
Summary
This role is focused on California insurance - personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate - you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.
Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations - managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For
The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

• They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer - but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

• They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it - then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

• They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception - they manage reality

• They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart - they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

• They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there - no exceptions, no grey areas

• They use AI the way a sharp operator would - not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here
People who are quietly excellent - not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.
We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem - it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

• You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track

• You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response

• You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice

• You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

• Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule

• You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans

• You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start

• Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy

There’s no judgment in that list - it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.
Responsibilities
You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.
That looks like:

• Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines - this is the core of the role

• Managing inbound communication across email and phone - triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs atten

title: Teach English From Home !
description:
Teach English Online!

• Stable Class Hours = Stable Income

• Fixed Student & Teacher pairing

• Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish :

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish :

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish . We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

• Native or near native pronunciation

• Great communication skills

• Commitment to responsibility

• Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred

• High-speed internet connection

• Access to a HD camera and mic

• Bachelors degree

• TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

• Complete your online job application.

• Complete an initial set of video questions.

• Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.

• Sign a contract and start teaching!

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PERFORMANCE MARKETING MANAGER

You'll build and optimize full-funnel campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms, turning paid media investment into qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue. This is a highly analytical, hands-on role with ownership spanning channel strategy, campaign execution, creative testing, landing-page experimentation, and measurement. You'll work closely with creative, content, product marketing, sales, lifecycle, data, and engineering to improve performance at every stage of the funnel, from the first impression through downstream conversion.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Paid acquisition: Own and scale paid acquisition across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms; build and optimize full-funnel campaigns that drive qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue, not just clicks

- Channel strategy: Develop channel strategy across search, paid social, retargeting, and experimentation budgets; manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, audience segmentation, and bidding to improve CAC and payback

- Creative & landing pages: Test ad copy and creative angles tailored to technical audiences; partner closely with creative, content, and product marketing to ship high-performing ad concepts and landing page iterations

- Comfort working cross-functionally in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment

title: Copy of Software Developer – AI Coding Assistant Evaluation

In this project, you will use an AI coding assistant to work on your existing software project. This may involve building new features, fixing bugs, refactoring code, or writing documentation. As you work, you will be presented with two versions of the AI assistant's response and asked to select the one that works better, along with a short explanation of your choice.
What You'll Do:

• Bring and work on a software project that you personally own and maintain in a Git repository.

• Use an AI coding assistant to build features, fix bugs, refactor code, and improve documentation.

• Review and compare two versions of AI-generated coding responses.

• Evaluate which response is more useful, accurate, and effective for your project.

• Provide clear, honest feedback explaining why you selected one response over the other.

• Work comfortably with terminal commands and Git during project sessions.

• Follow project guidelines and ensure that no passwords, API keys, or other people's personal information are included in your sessions.

Requirements:

• Experienced software developer with a personal software project that you own and maintain in a Git repository.

• Comfortable working with terminal commands and Git.

• Has a computer running macOS, Linux, or Windows with WSL2.

• Able to review and evaluate AI-generated code and coding suggestions.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and briefly.

• Able to provide independent and honest feedback without using AI assistance to write evaluation responses.

Nice to Haves:

• Experience building personal tools, applications, libraries, or other software projects.

• Experience with software debugging, feature development, code refactoring, and documentation.

•

•

description:
DEINE ROLLE

Als Senior Accountant bei Skalar verantwortest du die Buchhaltung und Abschlüsse unserer Mandanten: schnell wachsende und mittelständische Unternehmen. Die Routine übernehmen unsere Agenten. Du prüfst, was sie liefern, und löst Sonderfälle sauber. Du baust Prozesse auf, triffst fachliche Entscheidungen, löst Probleme von Mandanten systematisch und entwickelst mit unseren Engineers die Lösung, die danach für alle Mandate läuft.

Du arbeitest fachlich direkt mit unseren Steuerberater:innen, Tax-Operations-Kolleg:innen und Softwareentwickler:innen zusammen. Was du im Alltag lernst und gestaltest, fließt direkt in unsere Prozesse zurück und trägt mit unseren Agenten wesentlich zum Erfolg der Firma bei. Du führst kein Team, du trainierst Agenten: Jede Prüfregel, die du definierst, läuft über alle Mandate. Dein Hebel ist das System, nicht die Teamgröße.

DEINE AUFGABEN

LAUFENDE BUCHHALTUNG & ABSCHLÜSSE

- Du verantwortest Qualität und Abschlussreife eines Mandantenportfolios: FiBu, HGB-Abschlüsse, USt-Meldungen. Der Agent bucht, du entscheidest fachlich die Grenzfälle.

- Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB: Abgrenzungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagevermögen, Abstimmungen. Du prüfst, entscheidest und bringst sie bis zur Abschlussreife für unsere Steuerberater.

- Umsatzsteuer: UStVA und ZM validieren, Sonderfälle wie Reverse Charge, OSS und Drittland entscheiden und als Regel festhalten.

PROZESSE, DATEN & AUTOMATISIERUNG

- Validierung automatisierter Buchungen und Meldungen: Du definierst Prüfregeln, misst Fehlerquoten und verbesserst Regeln und Prompts laufend.

- Du findest, wo Zeit verloren geht, und baust mit unseren Engineers die Automatisierung.

TEAM & MANDANTEN

- Vertretung unserer Leads für Jahresabschluss und Finanzbuchhaltung, inklusive Freigaben

- Du verantwortest die Mandantenbeziehung zu Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussthemen, vorbereitet und unterstützt durch KI

- Steuerliche Fragen erkennst du früh und gibst sie buchhalterisch aufgearbeitet an unsere Steuerberater: Sachverhalt, Zahlen, deine Einschätzung

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- 6-10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Verantwortung für die Buchhaltung in einem Start-up oder Scale-up, idealerweise in mehr als einem Unternehmen

- Sicherheit in Monats- und Quartalsabschlüssen sowie in der Jahresabschlussvorbereitung nach HGB

- Sehr gute Steuerkenntnisse, vor allem in Umsatzsteuer (inkl. internationaler Sachverhalte), mit Grundlagen in Ertragsteuern im Abschlusskontext und im Verständnis von Lohnbuchungen

- Du hast Buchhaltungsprozesse selbst umgebaut: Systemwechsel, Schnittstellen (Bank, Payment, ERP) nach DATEV oder manuelle Schritte automatisiert. Du kennst DATEV und andere Buchhaltungs-Tools und weißt, wo Daten brechen.

- KI im Alltag: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude täglich, hast Buchhaltungsvorgänge automatisiert und formulierst Anforderungen so, dass Engineers sie bauen können.

- Die Fähigkeit, Buchhaltung für Nicht-Buchhalter:innen verständlich zu erklären

- Ausbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen oder Steuern

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch (Unternehmenssprache)

- Mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Münchner Office, für schnellere Abstimmung und Dynamik im Team

VON VORTEIL

- Berufsexamen (Steuerberater:in, Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachwirt:in) ist ein Plus. Was zählt, ist dein fachliches Urteil, nicht der Titel.

- Kanzlei- oder WP-Erfahrung, IFRS oder Konzernbilanzierung

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

- AI-natives Setup: Du baust den Buchhalter-Job der Zukunft. Die Agenten, die du heute trainierst, machen morgen die Routine. Du entscheidest, was sie lernen.

- Das Tooling, das du brauchst: Was fehlt, beschaffen wir oder unsere Softwareentwickler:innen bauen es mit dir

- Kurze Wege: Verbesserungen setzen wir schnell um, oft noch am selben Tag

- Klarer Karrierepfad mit transparenten Kriterien und Gehaltsentwicklung

- 28 Urlaubstage

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

As IT support specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for day-to-day IT support across our Berlin and Darmstadt offices, keeping employees connected, equipped, and secure so they can focus on building fusion technology. You will own the full IT support lifecycle at both sites, from ticket resolution and device management to onboarding and security compliance.

title: Supply Chain Operations Program Manager

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supply Chain Operations sits within Anduril's central Supply Chain organization. It owns how material actually arrives, and the data and systems behind it: what suppliers ship, how it is packaged, labeled, and documented; the EDI and Supplier Portal connections that carry purchase orders, shipments, and invoices; and whether all of it can be received, processed, and put to use without touching a person twice. We make the operational requirements executable at every dock and every connection, across a rapidly growing and diverse supplier network. The work is measured in problems permanently removed, not tickets closed.

ABOUT THE JOB

You are responsible for getting material through receiving at Anduril's Orange County sites and for getting suppliers to comply with delivery, packaging, and labeling requirements, not just acknowledge them. When material does not clear the dock, you resolve it, find the root cause, and fix it so it does not recur. You own execution: enforcement, evidence, and fixing what is broken on the receiving floor and in the supply base's compliance with our policies. This is a hands-on, on-site role: you will be on the receiving floor daily, working exceptions and supplier issues in person.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own receiving exception throughput for Anduril's sites: triage, drive to resolution, and reduce the recurrence rate of receiving failures

• Own receiving readiness through warehouse consolidation moves, taking migrated part families from cutover to first clean receipt without interrupting production

• Drive supplier execution of Anduril's delivery, packaging, labeling, and serialization requirements, including barcode and traceability marking

• Partner with Supplier Quality Engineering on root cause and corrective action for repeat receiving failures: own the receiving-side evidence, then verify at the dock that the fix held

• Make internal receiving and traceability requirements executable for suppliers through clear part-level instructions, documentation, and training

• Own the rollout of supplier-facing policies and requirements end to end: prioritize suppliers by spend, risk, category, and performance, then build the supplier lists, notices, FAQs, and acknowledgment tracking that move each policy from approved document to live practice

• Triage supplier questions, disputes, and exception requests on policies and requirements, routing each to the right internal owner and seeing it through to resolution

• Automate enforcement workflows, including issue detection, evidence intake, supplier notifications, and charge requests, and enforce supplier policies consistently, assessing recovery and escalating unresolved or repeat problems

• Pull your own data, define the metrics that matter, and publish recurring reporting on receiving performance and policy adoption by site and by supplier that leadership and suppliers both act on

• Identify the system and process defects behind receiving failures and policy non-adoption, build the evidence, and drive them to engineering or systems owners as fixes rather than absorbing them as recurring manual work

• Partner across Material Flow, Supplier Quality Engineering, Supplier Compliance, Procurement, Program Supply Chain, Financ

The Opportunity

As AI transitions from analysis into real-world autonomous action, enterprises require more than intelligent models-they need an ultra-low-latency operational fabric that connects agent swarms and workflows directly to live reality. That requires authoritative state, unified context, and enterprise-grade policy controls.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Aerospike , you will serve as the hands-on technical authority partnering with lead architects and engineering teams across Global 2000 enterprises. You will own the technical architecture and end-to-end implementation of mission-critical systems: discovering deep architectural challenges, writing core production code, validating high-throughput workloads, and driving post-production operational resilience.

Authoritative State Engines: Architect and implement real-time distributed foundations for session, entity, workflow, and multi-agent state. Support massive concurrent reads/writes under stringent SLA guarantees for data freshness, consistency, and sub-millisecond recovery.

Context Assembly Pipelines: Design systems that merge enterprise records, streaming state, low-latency vector search, and graph topologies to provide grounded, permission-aware context for autonomous decisions.

Execution Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Embed deterministic boundaries, authorization checks, rate/execution governors, and human-in-the-loop triggers directly into distributed data and execution paths.

•
Auditable Governance & Traceability: Build immutable telemetry and lineage pipelines that capture runtime context, decisions, downstream side-effects, and state mutations to meet enterprise security and compliance standards.

•
The Continuous Operating Loop: Build and tune closed-loop distributed systems: State → Context → Inference → Action → Consequence → State Mutation , ensuring deterministic execution at scale.

Drive System Architecture: Embed with enterprise staff/principal engineers and platform owners to break ambiguous, high-scale operational requirements into concrete systems designs, data schemas, and verifiable milestones.

Write Production Code: Write, optimize, and review high-performance code across Aerospike , distributed data backends, vector search runtimes, and agentic execution frameworks.

You’ll work closely with Finance, Engineering, Legal, and our vendor partners.

This is a lead role for the Procurement function. The operating model, the source of truth for vendor spend, and the standards are yours to define, against a clear position: this is a FinOps role first, not a pure procurement desk. You'll own the technical and analytical side of vendor management, reporting, efficiency, and the commercial interface across the company, while keeping procurement governance tight. It's ideal for someone fluent across finance and engineering, who thrives in async, fast-moving environments, and wants to build a function from the ground up rather than inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

- Own vendor relationships: run our primary cloud and SaaS vendor relationships end-to-end (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, CloudQuery, ClickHouse, and more), leading renewals and negotiations alongside Finance and Legal.

- Run procurement governance: enforce our competitive-bid process for incoming requests and manage larger procurement through our managed-procurement partner, keeping oversight and accountability with FinOps.

- People management: Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment. Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct report(s).Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

- Manage team’s delivery and accountability: Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones. Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

- Drive commercial VIA: own spend visibility and unit economics, surface licensing and usage inefficiency before it becomes a surprise, and drive renewals, right-sizing, and tooling consolidation to realized savings.

- Build reporting and governance: vendor and SaaS cost reporting is the unowned gap today and your highest-leverage area in the first year. Build the dashboards and reporting hands-on, partner with our data teams to scale them, and own the governance layer (spend policies, thresholds, accountability).

- Coordinate the cloud efficiency program: keep optimization initiatives visible and tracked from commitment to realized savings, partnering with Engineering without taking over their delivery.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 8+ years in vendor/commercial management, procurement, FinOps, or technical/financial analysis, at a senior, function-owning level.

- Have owned vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and renewals, and treat them as a lever on unit economics.

- Have run procurement governance such as competitive-bid processes, benchmark analysis, approval thresholds, or managed-procurement partners.

- Have high judgment and can hold a position and drive alignment without positional authority.

- Build cost dashboards and reporting hands-on (SQL, BI tools), and are comfortable with vendor and cloud spend data (AWS, GCP, SaaS billing) and licensing/usage analysis.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Have experience in async or globally distributed teams.

- Are energized by building a function from the ground up and navigating ambiguity.

WHAT WE OFFER

title: Strategic Account Executive, Federal Government (Australia)
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

At Verkada, we are transforming how organisations approach physical security. By combining cloud-native technology, AI-powered insights, and enterprise-grade security solutions, we help organisations protect the people and places that matter most.

We are looking for a Strategic Account Executive, Federal Government to build and lead our Federal Government business in Australia. This is a foundational role responsible for establishing Verkada’s presence across Commonwealth agencies, Defence, and critical government organisations.

You will own the full sales lifecycle from developing relationships and creating market awareness, through navigating complex procurement processes, managing strategic partnerships, and closing enterprise agreements.

This role is ideal for a proven government sales leader who understands how to operate in Canberra, has deep relationships across the Federal Government ecosystem, and is excited by the opportunity to build something from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and execute Verkada’s Federal Government sales strategy across Australia

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Commonwealth agencies, Defence, and government-owned organisations

• Create and manage a strategic account plan for priority Federal Government accounts

• Generate pipeline through direct engagement, partnerships, and ecosystem development

• Navigate complex government procurement processes including RFPs, tenders, panels, and long sales cycles

• Build relationships with key government partners, resellers, system integrators, and consulting organisations

• Collaborate with internal teams including Sales Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Leadership to support government opportunities

• Drive executive-level conversations focused on modernising physical security infrastructure

• Develop the Federal Government sales playbook and establish best practices for future growth

What You Bring

Experience:

• 8+ years of enterprise sales experience, with significant experience selling into Australian Federal Government

• Proven track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements

• Existing relationships across Commonwealth Government, Defence, or national security organisations

• Deep understanding of Australian Government procurement processes and buying cycles

• Experience selling security, infrastructure, hardware, SaaS, or technology solutions into government environments

• Strong network across government partners, system integrators, and consulting organisations

• Ability to operate strategically while also executing independently in a market-building role

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

Skills & Attributes:

• Executive Presence: Confident and polished, capable of leading meetings

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
